items.summary: Add a delivery charge logic to the backend: if the order total is below ₹51, apply a ₹5 delivery charge for delivery distances of 0.5km or under 1km. Orders of ₹51 or above qualify for free delivery regardless of distance within that range.

Update the checkout page to display the delivery charge breakdown: show ₹5 delivery fee line item when the cart total is below ₹51 and distance is within 0.5km–1km, and show 'Free Delivery' when the order meets the ₹51 minimum. The final order total shown to the user must include the delivery charge where applicable.
On the shop/home page, display a small green text label 'Delivery in 10 Mins' directly below every product name in the product card component (ProductCard.tsx).
